text_block_list.text: (Murmur, murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, is that really true!?
Word is Biwa Hayahide-san's injury from last year's Tenno Sho (Autumn)
hasn't healed, so she might have to retire...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Apparently so. *sigh*... What a shame.
I really liked Hayahide-san's running style, too.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I know, right? I really wanted to see
a direct showdown with Brian-san.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Brian.
Would you care to have a mock race with me sometime?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the day we can face off as friendly rivals.
Normal race distances are out of the question for me, but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Brian, run as far ahead as you can.
Just keep sprinting forward without looking back.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Why did you say
it was impossible back then?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Why did I say "don't look back"...!!

With her next major goal set on the Japan Cup,
Narita Brian tackled her training
with terrifying intensity.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
*wheeze*... *gasp*...!
*wheeze*... *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Haa... Trainer...
One more set... Let's go...!
choice_data_list: Make sure you catch your breath properly first.
Make sure you get your breathing under control first, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Narita Brian-san!
Excuse me, could I get an interview?
Just a few words would be plenty!
choice_data_list: I'm in the middle of training right now, so...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Please, work with us here!
Now that Biwa Hayahide's return to the Twinkle Series looks hopeless, you are the only one who—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Cut it out.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Stop talking about Sis!!

In that instant, the air in the room freezes.
Her voice carries an extraordinary amount of wrath.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Damn it!

I bowed to the pale-faced reporter
and hurried after Narita Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Ghh!! What good is chasing
a phantom you can never reach?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Someone who spouts such spineless nonsense
is no sister of mine—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Ghh, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about earlier.
I'll head back to the training course later.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Pay no mind to me right now.
Make yourself scarce, at once.

The news reports I saw after the recent Tenno Sho (Autumn).
And what the reporters had said.

Narita Brian tended to have
an overly extreme reaction
whenever it came to her sister, Biwa Hayahide.
choice_data_list: Are you talking about your older sister?
Are you talking about your older sister?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Stop!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Stop it.
Don't... talk about my sister.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: My big sis is—

text_block_list.name: Young Hayahide
text_block_list.text: —Come, Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: She was always running ahead of me...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I won't give up on the race
that easily...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Just leave me alone already...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I understand that.
Even without Big Sis, the Twinkle Series is full of rivals to race against.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
This is a place where only the brave can remain.
It's only natural that some will get thrown off.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Even if that was Big Sis...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...You haven't returned.
That simple fact says it all.
choice_data_list: Facts and feelings are two different things.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Becoming someone who hurts others...
is scary, sad, and awful. But...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice doesn't want to run away
from racing, though...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Your back was always so far away,
and in the end, I could never reach you.
...I guess that's just the 'normal' outcome, isn't it?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: “Still, next time for sure! I'll catch up to you!”
—Even that girl they called the “Jet-Black Assassin”.
Even that girl who everyone thought "could never win".

Both of them harbored "feelings"
that differed from the facts perceived by others.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
choice_data_list: I think your older sister feels the same way.
I think your big sister feels the same way.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...She's my big sis, so of course
she's strong... dammit!!

I gently closed my eyes and turned away,
so as not to get in her way.

From behind, the sound of sobbing
could be heard bursting out like a broken dam.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Hayahide? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...I was just wondering
if that girl is doing her best right about now too."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Well, we can't afford to lose either.
Are the tickets ready?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Okay!! Teacherrrr!!!

text_block_list.name: Physical Therapist
text_block_list.text:
Right, I've been waiting for you!
We're going to be strict with today's rehab as well.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Yes, please!

text_block_list.name: Physical Therapist
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu, your drive hasn't waned at all since last year.
You're truly wonderful, Hayahide-san and everyone.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course.
I want to make my comeback as soon as possible, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...There's no need for unnecessary worry.
After all, I am Narita Brian's older sister.
